# UFC Fight Predictions

## Random Forest Model

### Preparation

```{r}
ufc_model <- readRDS("ufc_model.rds")
labels <- ufc_model$Winner
predictors <- ufc_model[, !names(ufc_model) %in% c("Winner", "R_fighter", "B_fighter")]

keep <- complete.cases(predictors) & labels %in% c("Red", "Blue")
predictors <- droplevels(predictors[keep, ])
labels <- droplevels(labels[keep])

x <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = predictors)

minmax <- function(v) {
  r <- range(v)
  if (r[2] == r[1]) return(rep(0, length(v)))
  (v - r[1]) / (r[2] - r[1])
}
x_scaled <- as.data.frame(apply(x, 2, minmax))

rf_data <- data.frame(x_scaled, Winner = labels)

# Split dataset into training and test 
set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(rf_data), 0.7 * nrow(rf_data))
rf_train <- rf_data[train_rows, ]
rf_test  <- rf_data[-train_rows, ]
```

### Build Model

```{r}
library(randomForest)
rf_model <- randomForest(Winner ~ ., data = rf_train, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)
rf_model

rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, rf_test[, names(rf_test) != "Winner"]) # Make prediction from model
```

### Evaluate Model

```{r}
library(caret)
all_levels <- c("Red", "Blue")
confusionMatrix(factor(rf_pred, levels = all_levels),
                factor(rf_test$Winner, levels = all_levels),
                positive = "Red")

varImpPlot(rf_model, n.var = 15) # Viewing the most important independent variables
```

R_odds and B_odds seem to be the two most consequential predictors.
